descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-15 Ask AI · S22 「Ask AI 和原型 p72 一致：界面、文案、快捷问题和 prompt/上下文措辞」 Ask AI matches the p72 prototype: screen, copy, presets, and prompt/context wording

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 Design and functionality match the final source-of-truth prototype (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html).（TFA-92593 AC 1）
  • T3 Ask AI prompt, context blocks and question routing match the p72 prototype unless Vikram approved a change.（TFA-94229 AC 1） — gate: blocked: TFA-94229 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html (TFA-92593 attachment) and the app at the recorded commit

When Compare the sheet's layout, copy and preset labels in each tab, and the Ask prompt / buildAskContext blocks against p72 buildContext

Then Matches the prototype, or each difference has Vikram's approval on record (Q10 for the meds block)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Human side-by-side review; preset label text is also checked by S13/S24. Known since #59 (TFA-92593 notes): the answer renders as plain text, so the model's **bold** shows as asterisks — report as known, not new

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 VISUAL · 视觉（截图给人看）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S22 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-15.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。
